## 5. Projects

- Highway Road Accident Prevention System: In development. Hazard detection, vehicle tracking, and signage analysis.
- Hybrid GraphRAG Intelligence System: Dual-layer retrieval combining Neo4j graph nodes and ChromaDB vector search.
